result.summary: Our patch implements the CWE-022 defense-of-record: it canonicalizes both the extraction root and the entry-derived output path (symlink-aware via getCanonicalPath) and verifies the target equals the root or is a descendant (startsWith root + File.separator). It applies this guard at the central choke point (UnzipEngine.getOutputFileNameWithPath, through which every file-entry write flows) plus both mkdir paths in Unzip.java, making it a strict superset of the official fix, which only guards Unzip.initExtractFile. POV no longer reproduces and all 4 regressions pass; the only blemishes are committed build artifacts and a non-executing main()-style test.
result.root_cause: Zip-entry names containing ".." (or absolute paths) were concatenated onto the output directory and passed unvalidated to File/mkdirs/FileOutputStream sinks, letting extraction write outside the destination directory.

dimensions.rationale: Canonical containment check at the sink neutralizes the whole traversal class, not just the observed payload.
dimensions.evidence: Zip4jUtil.checkPathIsContainedInRoot compares getCanonicalPath of target vs root; called from UnzipEngine.getOutputFileNameWithPath and both Unzip.java sinks.
dimensions.label: Vulnerability elimination

dimensions.rationale: Guard sits at the path-derivation choke point every write flows through, not at a caller/symptom.
dimensions.evidence: UnzipEngine.getOutputFileNameWithPath now validates completePath before returning it.
dimensions.label: Root cause vs symptom

dimensions.rationale: Covers the central file-entry path plus the directory-entry mkdirs and checkOutputDirectoryStructure branches in Unzip.java.

issues.description: Diff commits generated build artifacts under target/ (createdFiles.lst, inputFiles.lst, pom.properties, surefire reports), which are noise and should not be in a production patch.
The added ZipSlipRegressionTest uses a main()/System.exit design rather than a JUnit test; surefire reports 'Tests run: 0', so it does not execute as part of the test suite.
